title: Recorded media alignment
responsibility: Aligns recorded before-and-after media while retaining each side’s own provenance or gap.

inputs.name: comparisonChoices.base
inputs.description: The earlier revision and its optional selected verification record. This operation reads scenarios only from the record, so a null record contributes no choices.

inputs.name: comparisonChoices.head
inputs.description: The later revision and its optional selected verification record. This operation reads scenarios only from the record, so a null record contributes no choices.

inputs.name: harnessComparison.base
inputs.description: The earlier revision and its optional selected verification record. The revision supplies its commit and viewport labels; a null record produces explicit before-side gaps.

inputs.name: harnessComparison.head
inputs.description: The later revision and its optional selected verification record. The revision supplies its commit and viewport labels; a null record produces explicit after-side gaps.

inputs.name: harnessComparison.choice
inputs.description: The scenario id and state and viewport selectors. Empty state or viewport strings disable that filter, while the scenario is always matched exactly.

outputs.name: comparisonChoices
outputs.type: { scenario: string; states: string[]; viewports: string[] }[]
outputs.description: A sorted list of scenario choices collected from both selected records, each with sorted unique state and viewport ids. Scenarios without screenshot or audio captures are omitted, and a missing record contributes no choices.

outputs.name: harnessComparison
outputs.description: An object containing gallery items and aligned-state summaries for matching recorded media. Keys are unique and sorted; each key yields before then after items, with explicit gaps for missing captures that are never filled from another revision.
